mismatch.message: simple monster action requires uhitm.c mhitm_ad_deth()

summary: The monster-action preflight refuses AD_DETH before Death’s turn. C step30 enters mhitm_ad_deth and rn2(20)=6 selects life-force draining with mhm.permdmg=1. Port the whole helper and AD_DETH dispatch arm, preserving the caller’s permanent-damage handling and all source orientations.

source.branch: AD_DETH with a non-undead hero defender; rn2(20)=6 selects permanent life-force damage. Other source arms halve undead-hero damage, invoke touch_of_death without Antimagic, clear failed damage, or delegate monster-defender draining.

evidence: uhitm.c:3837–3893 defines mhitm_ad_deth. Its hero-defender rn2(20) switch sets permdmg on the life-force branch; it leaves actual damage application to hitmu.
C step30 prints the deadly-touch message and records rnd(20)=8 at mattacku, d(8,8)=37 at hitmu, then rn2(20)=6 at mhitm_ad_deth. Space continues the life-force message at31.

JS uhitm.js:5073 still selects the unported mhitm_ad_deth helper. The baseline reports this exact simple-monster-action refusal, so the earlier missing distfleeck draw is a planning symptom of the unsupported damage type.

The whole source unit also calls touch_of_death and mhitm_ad_drli with discarded results; audit their source and existing owners when defining implementation scope. Do not claim the life-force recording covers those alternate branches.
